Use case: scientific-educational. Create a brand NEW unlabeled PNG background for a Chinese machine learning textbook; all supplied images are EXTERNAL scientific mechanism references only, not edit targets or layout templates. Invent a fresh clear composition appropriate to the following objects and relations. Flat 2D technical illustration, pure #FFFFFF background and perfectly uniform solid opaque fills. Lancet muted Blue #7B95C6, Green #67A583, Peach #FFC1A6 and Rose #C85E62 with very pale fixed white mixes. Neutral thin wires #4C4D4F. Many modules can remain white with colored outlines; restrained pale grouping only where it explains a relation. Crisp planar mechanism glyphs and accurate connections, readable blank areas. No 3D, perspective, side faces, extrusions, shadows, gloss, gradients, paper/canvas texture, noise, grain, waves, stripes, cloudy color variation or decorative card grids. At most one decorative icon per frame; equivalent frames consistently use the same or no icon. Mechanism nodes, vectors, documents and samples are allowed. NO text, letters, digits, formulas, plus/minus signs, pseudowriting, watermark or legends anywhere. Reserve adjacent or internal blank title/variable spaces; all lettering added later from actual fonts. Never put a decorative icon where a title must sit. Generous outer white margins. Landscape composition.
Scientific mechanism: Activation patching controlled comparison using THREE parallel runs of SAME fixed neural model parameters, NOT parameter editing. Exactly three rows; each row incoming token-strip/input glyph → first computation block → selected middle activation tile → later computation block → output-score blank box. First row clean input and green activation. Second row corrupted input and rose activation. Third row SAME corrupted input glyph as second row, but selected middle activation is green replacing corrupted value at exactly same layer/position. ONLY copy arrow from first row selected green activation down to third row selected activation, passing by second-row state WITHOUT branching/patching second row. All other activations/computation remain corrupted-run computation. No arrow copying model weights, outputscore, or whole row. Three model rows align to clarify controlled intervention. Leave blank row labels on far left, blank scores at right for actual later values 4/0/3, and ample bottom blank formula area for normalized restoration .75. Data values later explicitly illustrative. Diagram no graphs/bar charts.

science_brief.title: 干净、受损与激活替换三次运行
science_brief.understanding_gap: 目前已有输入归因条与几何反事实，却没有内部机制干预图；读者容易把读取激活或输入遮挡等同于因果追踪。
proposed_mechanism: 显示同一固定模型的干净运行、受损运行、在指定层/位置替换干净激活后继续前向三次计算。
干净激活只送到受损运行选定内部位置，参数固定；输出评分比较4、0、3与恢复比例0.75是教学构造，以真实字体排字。
不能把0.75称为存储75%知识，也不画成完整机制证明。

caption: 同一固定参数模型先进行干净运行和受损运行，再在同一层、同一位置换入干净激活并继续前向。图中4、0、3为教学示例，恢复比例为(3−0)/(4−0)=0.75；它只表示该干预设置中的局部恢复，不是模型知识量的比例，也不证明唯一存储位置。绿色复制线与第二行灰色计算线的交叉无连接点。
